Once the steel doors seal, the silence becomes deafening.

meta.title: Why This Silent Room Will Make You Hallucinate #shorts
meta.description:
Have you ever wanted absolute peace and quiet? Be careful what you wish for. Deep inside Minneapolis, there is a room designed to absorb ninety-nine point nine percent of all sound. It is so quiet that the longest anyone has ever survived inside is just forty-five minutes. Once the steel doors seal, the silence becomes deafening. Your ears adapt, and suddenly you hear things you were never meant to hear. You will hear your lungs scraping, blood rushing through your veins, and even the high-pitched hum of your own nervous system. Within minutes, you lose your balance because there is no echo to orient you. Soon, your brain starts making up sounds, causing vivid hallucinations. Could you survive an hour in this room, or would you lose your mind? Subscribe for more mind-blowing facts.
